title: A*STAR Graduate Scholarship (AGS)
official_source: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR), A*STAR Graduate Academy
description: A*STAR Graduate Scholarship (AGS) funds up to four years of PhD or EngD study at an autonomous university in Singapore, jointly supervised by an A*STAR researcher and a university faculty member, with research conducted at an A*STAR Research Institute. Support published for up to 4 years comprises full tuition fees, a monthly sustenance allowance inclusive of CPF contribution where applicable, book, computer, conference and thesis allowances, and support for up to 12 months of overseas attachment. title: NUS Research Scholarship
funding: Full Tuition Fee Waiver + Monthly Stipend
official_source: NUS Graduate School, National University of Singapore
duration: Typical award period 4 years for PhD students and 2 years for Master's (Research) students; tenable for one year in the first instance and renewable each semester.
description: The NUS Research Scholarship is awarded by the NUS Graduate School to outstanding graduate students for research leading to a higher degree at the National University of Singapore. title: Commonwealth Scholarship
description: The Commonwealth Scholarship is awarded by the NUS Graduate School to outstanding graduate students from Commonwealth countries for research leading to a higher degree at the National University of Singapore. It is for new, incoming students who are not Singapore citizens or permanent residents and consists of a monthly stipend plus a subsidy for full tuition fees at the University. Stipend rates effective from 1 January 2026 are SGD 3,000 per month for PhD candidates and SGD 2,900 per month for Master's (Research) candidates. title: President's Graduate Fellowship
funding: Full Tuition Fee Waiver + Monthly Stipend
official_source: NUS Graduate School, National University of Singapore
duration: One (1) year in the first instance, renewable each semester; maximum period four (4) years. Typical award period for PhD students is 4 years.
description: The President's Graduate Fellowship is awarded by the NUS Graduate School to PhD candidates who show exceptional promise or accomplishment in research, and a number of PhD research students are selected each semester by the University. It is open to Singapore Citizens, Singapore Permanent Residents and all international students, covers a full waiver of tuition fees at the University and pays a monthly stipend of SGD 3,900 for international students, SGD 4,400 for Permanent Residents and SGD 4,800 for Singapore Citizens, with CPF contributions on top for Citizens. title: NUS International Undergraduate Scholarship
funding: Full Tuition Fee Coverage + Living and Accommodation Allowances
official_source: National University of Singapore, Office of Admissions
duration: The scholarship is tenable for the normal candidature period and can be transferred across programmes; renewed every semester provided the GPA and conduct conditions are met.
description: The NUS International Undergraduate Scholarship is a University-level scholarship offered by the National University of Singapore to support exceptional students from all countries except Singapore who apply as freshmen to a full-time undergraduate degree programme at NUS. Candidates are considered and shortlisted through their application for undergraduate admission to NUS, and selection interviews are held from January to July with outcomes notified by mid-July. title: Nanyang Global Scholarship
funding: Full Tuition Fee Coverage + Living and Accommodation Allowances
official_source: Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Office of Admissions
duration: The scholarship covers up to the normal programme duration on condition that the scholarship holder maintains a record of good academic performance and exemplary conduct.

title: Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship
funding: Full Tuition Fee + Monthly Stipend + Allowances
duration: The award is tenable for one year in the first instance and is renewable subject to good progress. The maximum period of the Scholarship is 4 years for PhD candidates, as determined by school as well as availability of research funding in each case.
description: The Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship (NPGS) is a competitive and prestigious scholarship scheme offered by Nanyang Technological University to encourage outstanding graduates or final-year students to take their first step towards a leading research career by studying full-time for a PhD at NTU. It is described as the premier scholarship granted by NTU's President, recognising PhD students who exemplify exceptional academic, research and leadership qualities.
